Stream observations

stream_obs.Rd

Date-indexed records of streams documenting excavation of a Minecraft hole for a Nether farm. Jamie Gumbrell collected and recorded these observations. The source records span November 2016 to August 2017 using a provisional start year of 2016; update `FIRST_STREAM_YEAR` in `data-raw/extract.R` when Jamie confirms the year.

Usage

stream_obs

Format

A data frame with 188 rows and 13 variables:

date

Stream date, using the provisional source year.

total_minutes

Recorded total duration in minutes.

total_blocks_mined

Recorded total blocks mined per stream.

method

Recorded digging method.

pick_start, pick_end

Source counter readings; their meaning is pending confirmation from Jamie.

hours, minutes

Duration split from `total_minutes`.

cumulative_total_minutes

Running total of `total_minutes` in source order.

cumulative_hours

`cumulative_total_minutes` divided by 60.

blocks_per_hour

`total_blocks_mined` divided by stream hours.

cumulative_blocks_mined

Running total of `total_blocks_mined` in source order.

cumulative_blocks_per_hour

Cumulative blocks divided by cumulative hours.

Complete observation rows run from 2016-11-05 to 2017-08-10 under the provisional year assumption. The year is unverified. Calculated fields use full precision; round values only for display.

Source

Doug's Nether Perimeter source spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1jrO-xAbp_sMstrJlWC6fsNnBINRrmrwquY-oOr8zW5o/edit?gid=44479275
